canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Talia Greleth: 40-year-old woman, 165 cm (medium), healthy slight, narrow, long-limbed construction with low mass, skin value band-6-deepest. Face: angular diamond face; full cheeks and sharply defined brows; broad low bridge, full lips; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blue-teal, bun-topknot-wrapped, deliberate accent: offset gathered mass. Wardrobe: tunic-tabard, specifically a long tunic and split tabard over loose trousers with wrapped ankles; visible hand repairs and contrasting inner edges; bounded palette teal-brown. Visible personal details: one hand-sized botanical shoulder tattoo; a tiny nose stud; one asymmetric ear cuff. Make stitching, quilting, embroidery, or woven pattern the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: low-maintenance grooming with highly polished footwear. Color treatment: uses high-contrast lining visible only in motion. Pose cue: stance is broad and still, with one palm turned slightly upward. Include a blunt carpenter's chalk only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
